items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know Joel Kaye? ... [INTERVIEWEE] The drummer? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, terrific. He has those charts?

ctx.x: I had to tell him how much I thought of that tune. It was really great. We became friends after that.
Do you know Joel Kaye? I'm sure you know Joel Kaye.
